decisions.quote:
For the Hypothesized and Alt1 models, prior specifications and parameter structure were
matched to Lin et al. (2026). Our Stan implementation differed only in computational details,
most notably the use of a non-centered parameterization to improve sampling efficiency; the
underlying mathematical model is equivalent, and the recovered parameter estimates closely
reproduced the original results.
decisions.reason: The authors explicitly re-estimated the original Hypothesized and Alt1 models on the Study 1 dataset before testing their extended specification and report that the recovered parameter estimates and WAIC comparisons closely reproduced the original results reported by Lin et al. (2026). Under the codebook rules for Axis 1 (outcome_computation), obtaining the original reported numbers again (even with a reimplemented non-centered parameterization in Stan) codes as 'computationally reproducible', not 'not checked'.
